conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower monthly gains, focusing on capital preservation. Expect reduced volatility and smaller drawdowns, but also slower growth compared to other modes.

balanced.read: This balanced mode seeks steady growth while managing risk. It blends broad market exposure with quality tech and limited leverage, aiming for moderate gains with controlled drawdowns.

income.read: This income-focused mode aims for consistent monthly distributions by shifting to income-generating assets like QQQI. It prioritizes capital preservation and low volatility over aggressive growth, with minimal exposure to high-beta tech.
